messages:
Samira Khan: Quick ask — webinar + benchmark post on 10/14. Goal = product-led signups + 100 qualified leads. Need final social plan and paid boost allocation by EOD tomorrow.
Ben Ortiz: I can draft copy & headline variants. Do we want a benchmark narrative asset to accompany the post (1 pager + chart)?
Rachel Li: Yes — benchmark snapshot showing cost/latency tradeoff across 3 approaches (baseline, batching+cache, quantized). Ill pull a draft chart.
Lucas Martin: Posting cadence suggestion: X thread at 10:00 PT (primary), LinkedIn long-form at 10:05 PT, follow-up LI comment with a CTAs at +45m. Paid boost start at 10:00 PT for 6 hours targeting NA dev/PM audiences.
Priya Nair: Seedlist prep: Ill export prioritized list (enterprise PMs first, then startups). Also adding a column for recent infra mentions (past 6 months). Link will be in Drive.
growth-bot: Suggested paid budget allocation: organic -> organic seeding, paid -> $800 total split: X (60%), LinkedIn (40%). Estimated reach = 60k impressions.
Ben Ortiz: Draft X copy variant A (benchmark lead): "New: benchmark — real-world inference configs that cut cost by up to 7x. Join our webinar for the how-to. Register: https://redwood.ai/oct-bench #LLM #SRE"
Ben Ortiz: Draft X copy variant B (webinar lead): "Free 30m webinar: production tricks that reduce inference spend and speed up responses. 10/14. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/oct-bench"
Rachel Li: Benchmark blurb for the carousel image: "Measured on 8–16GB sequences across public models. Batch + prefix cache gives the best cost/latency balance for steady traffic."
Samira Khan: Creative ask: two carousel images + one hero (1200x628) and a data slide (1200x1200). Lucas, can you confirm image export specs?
Lucas Martin: Confirmed specs: hero 1200x628 (X), hero crop 1200x675 (LinkedIn), carousel 1200x1200. Export as PNG + optimized JPG for Buffer.
Priya Nair: Drive links: seedlist -> https://drive.google.com/seed/octbench_1014.csv; creative folder -> https://drive.google.com/creative/octbench_images
Ben Ortiz: UTM pattern: ?utm_source=organic_social&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=octbench2025&utm_content={variant}
Samira Khan: For paid boosts, well run A/B on X headline (A=cost, B=throughput). Can marketing ops set up two boost creatives and split test 50/50?
growth-bot: Boost config: X boost A (cost) $480, X boost B (throughput) $0 (organic variant) — or do split $480/$320? Recommend split $480 X / $320 LI for best CPL.
Lucas Martin: Ops will do 50/50 creative split on X using two tweet IDs. Need final tweets saved and pinned in draft account.
Rachel Li: Data slide draft uploaded: octbench_slide_v1.png. Chart shows median latency and per-token cost across profiles. Feedback welcome in comments.
Priya Nair: Seedlist note: deduped against CRM, added timezone column. SDR queue mapping will be 1/2/3 based on org size and interaction (click or reply).
Samira Khan: Engagement playbook (short): - Monitor mentions + replies for first 2 hours - Tag high-intent replies (asks about pricing/usage) and move to SDR queue - Use DM template for quick qual: "Thanks for the interest — can I ask what scale you're serving at?"
Ben Ortiz: Can we include a short pinned reply on X with quick benchmark highlights + registration link? Makes sense to pin to increase CTR.
Lucas Martin: Yep. We'll post the thread root, then immediate reply pinned with the registration link and the benchmark image carousel.
growth-bot: Analytics: add campaign tag octbench2025 and creative tag {A|B}. Please ensure paid boost UTMs override organic ones when applicable.
Rachel Li: Small note — the benchmark uses synthetic traffic for privacy. We should add a caption: "Internal benchmark — your results may vary" to avoid misinterpretation.
Samira Khan: Good call. Add that caption to the carousel data slide.
Priya Nair: Final timeline recap: 10/13 EOD -> final copy & creative; 10/14 09:00 PT -> ops check; 10:00 PT -> publish. SDRs on standby 10:00-16:00 PT.
Ben Ortiz: I'll upload final copy variants to the creative folder and tag them copy_final_A.txt and copy_final_B.txt.
Rachel Li: Uploaded v2 of slide with caption and a lightweight alt-text for accessibility.
Lucas Martin: Scheduling note for Buffer: X thread (root + pinned reply + 2 follow-ups); LI post + follow-up comment; run paid boosts with split config.
Samira Khan: Thanks team. Leaving thread open for any last-minute ask. :sparkles:
Ben Ortiz: One last thing — let's collect top 5 replies after the first hour for a follow-up mini-press release or quote card. Ill monitor and save candidates.
Priya Nair: Seedlist handed to SDR queue once we confirm publish.
growth-bot: Campaign created in analytics: octbench2025. Tracking ready.
